parsed.post: Discarding the last experiment (1.070861) as it did not beat the depth 6 baseline (1.029087). Reverting to 023aaea. I believe the learning rate was still too high for this capacity. For the next run, I will decrease MATRIX_LR to 0.01 to find a better stability-to-convergence balance.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate to 0.01 to stabilize training at DEPTH=6 and ensure better convergence within the 5-minute limit.
